doc:
The residual floor is fixed to the next band.  Only exact physical
realizations of finite prefixes enter the residual part of the proof.

    {KA0 : Type u_4} {IP0 : Type u_5} {KP0 : Type u_6} (R : NavierStokes.ActualStageEstimates.RunData B N0)
    (M :
      NavierStokes.ActualMeanPhysicalData.InitialCycleInput B N0 N fun (x : ℕ) =>
        NavierStokes.ActualCycleParameters.fixedParameters B N0)
    (hN : 4 ≤ N) (W : NavierStokes.GluedStageEstimates.SignedInputs D I K)
    (particularA : ℕ → NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.VelocityField)
    (particularP : ℕ → NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.PressureField) {qbig : ℝ}
    (hq : qbig ≤ NavierStokes.ChartScales.Q N)
    (WA :
      NavierStokes.PhysicalStageBounds.WaveData NavierStokes.CorrectionInitialization.ActualPrimary.h DA0 IA0 KA0
        (Fin 3))
    (WP :
      NavierStokes.PhysicalStageBounds.WaveData NavierStokes.CorrectionInitialization.ActualPrimary.h DP0 IP0 KP0 Unit)
    {A Bdirect : ℕ → NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.VelocityField} {P : ℕ → NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.PressureField}
    (e : NavierStokes.GluedStageEstimates.Representations R M hN W particularA particularP WA WP A Bdirect P)
    {LA LP : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hsA :
      ∀ (j : ℕ),
        ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (particularA j)
          (NavierStokes.CutStageEstimates.physicalSublevel NavierStokes.CorrectionInitialization.ActualPrimary.h qbig))
    (hsP :
      ∀ (j : ℕ),
        ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (particularP j)
          (NavierStokes.CutStageEstimates.physicalSublevel NavierStokes.CorrectionInitialization.ActualPrimary.h qbig))
    (hbA :
      ∀ (j m : ℕ),
        NavierStokes.GluedStageEstimates.Bound qbig (particularA j) m
          (NavierStokes.ActualIterationLedger.gain NavierStokes.CorrectionInitialization.ActualPrimary.h (j + 1) -
            LA m))
    (hbP :
      ∀ (j m : ℕ),
        NavierStokes.GluedStageEstimates.Bound qbig (particularP j) m
          (NavierStokes.ActualIterationLedger.gain NavierStokes.CorrectionInitialization.ActualPrimary.h (j + 1) -
            LP m))
    (hqbig : 0 < qbig) (hGeom : NavierStokes.ActualCarrierGeometry.geometricThreshold ≤ N0)
    (d :
      ∀ (J : ℕ),
        NavierStokes.ActualCycleResidualBounds.PhysicalData B (N + 1)
          (NavierStokes.ActualCyclePreservation.state B N0 J).state
          (NavierStokes.MixedDiagonalResidual.uncutVelocity A Bdirect J)
          (NavierStokes.DiagonalJetBounds.uncutPrefix P (J + 1))) =>
  have hr := ⋯;
  let CA := hr.choose;
  let CB := ⋯.choose;
  let CP := ⋯.choose;
  have hc := ⋯;
  have hsa := ⋯;
  have hsb := ⋯;
  have hsp := ⋯;
  { potential_smooth := hsa, direct_smooth := hsb, pressure_smooth := hsp,

    gain_zero := NavierStokes.GluedStageEstimates.stageEstimates_of_component_bounds._proof_5,
    gain_pos := NavierStokes.GluedStageEstimates.stageEstimates_of_component_bounds._proof_6,
    gain_mono := NavierStokes.GluedStageEstimates.stageEstimates_of_component_bounds._proof_7,
    gain_top := NavierStokes.GluedStageEstimates.stageEstimates_of_component_bounds._proof_8,
    potentialLoss := NavierStokes.GluedStageEstimates.potentialLoss LA,
    directLoss := NavierStokes.PhysicalStageBounds.directLoss NavierStokes.CorrectionInitialization.ActualPrimary.h 0,
